scenarios.injection_method: Invocations targeting unregistered or offline server process
scenarios.expected_behavior: Immediate fail-closed with structured CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE error

scenarios.injection_method: Socket address resolution mock injection raising OSError(DNS Name Resolution Failed)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Fail-closed with structured network acquisition exception

scenarios.injection_method: Non-JSON HTML gateway error payload injection
scenarios.expected_behavior: Strict JSON parse rejection without leaking internal parser memory
scenarios.actual_behavior: JSONDecodeError caught, sanitized into structured PROVIDER_MALFORMED error

scenarios.injection_method: Corrupted non-media byte stream input causing non-zero exit code
scenarios.expected_behavior: ProcessExecutionFailedError raised; workspace scratch directory deleted
scenarios.actual_behavior: Subprocess exited code 1; base_scratch_dir job folders fully purged

scenarios.injection_method: Infinite sleep subprocess injection exceeding configured timeout
scenarios.expected_behavior: ProcessTimeoutError raised; process group receives SIGKILL; zero orphan pid
scenarios.actual_behavior: Timed out within 1.0s; SIGKILL executed via process group reaper

scenarios.injection_method: IOError(Disk quota exceeded) injection during final artifact publish
scenarios.expected_behavior: StoragePublishFailedError raised; no partial key registered; scratch cleaned
scenarios.actual_behavior: Publish failed gracefully; scratch directory unlinked

scenarios.injection_method: Simulated secondary worker execution using identical idempotency key
scenarios.expected_behavior: Idempotent deduction; zero double publish; zero duplicate artifact mutation
scenarios.actual_behavior: Secondary execution identified existing completion; returned ALREADY_COMPLETED

scenarios.injection_method: Corrupted non-JSON bytes written to active cache key entry file
scenarios.expected_behavior: Cache miss fallback to canonical computation; zero poisoned cache hits
scenarios.actual_behavior: Corrupted entry safely discarded; recomputed from source of record

scenarios.injection_method: Async task cancellation signal dispatched mid-flight during processing
scenarios.expected_behavior: CancelledError raised; active workers terminated; scratch purged; status CANCELLED
scenarios.actual_behavior: Task cancelled cleanly within 2ms; zero false success emitted
